answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, essentially a digital shale deposit, to validate transactions. This economic weight ensures that identity proliferation remains costly. Much like a vast meadow requires labor to maintain, network security demands resource commitment. An attacker must acquire substantial saffron-level liquidity to overwhelm the consensus, as any attempt to inflate fake nodes without capital dilution simply burns the attacker’s own wealth.
